Source counter: page header "Total Shipments 17 Records detected", 5 rows actually displayed; ports table shows JNPT 5 / Jebel Ali 5. Note: the only outbound lane is a single 2024-10-29 consignment to Jebel Ali described as EXHIBITION GOODS (samples for Canton Fair-type display), i.e. a real customs-recorded export but commercial-scale export volumes are not evidenced.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and volza.com / eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403. ImportKey inbound records (604 total, latest 2026-01-09, e.g. "2026-01-09 | JIEYANG JIEDONG PANDONG JU XINLONG HARDWARE | IPSA BUSINESS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | MOULD FOR 3D NEW CABINET HINGE INNER ARM | GUANGZHOU, CHINA | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 84804900 | 6803670") prove the company is an active importer/distributor of hinges and hardware into India, but import records are not domestic supply evidence. Domestic supply: not public in sources reachable — null.
note: Role: importer/distributor of furniture hardware (hinges, locks, handles, drawer slides) — trader, not manufacturer; declared HS 830130/830140/830160/830210 matches the observed cargo (83021090, 83014090, 83024900, 83024110), so no HS correction needed. Export side: one confirmed customs record (B/L 5244072, 2024-10-29, JNPT→Jebel Ali, UAE, exhibition goods) — real but sample/exhibition scale, not recurring commercial export. Domestic side: no GST turnover, tender or contract evidence found in reachable sources; inbound import records (604, latest 2026-01-09) show an active India-side operation but do not by themselves prove domestic sales. Revenue and export volume: null (not public). No sanctions/court/registry checks performed — out of scope for this role.
